key_insight: A pre-trained transformer accelerates conversion of opaque neural A-life policies into compact symbolic policies for human interpretation and agent-to-agent knowledge sharing.
engineering_relevance: Symbolic policies offer a compact way to transfer behavior across agents with different neural architectures without sharing incompatible neural weights.
method: Pre-train a transformer on readily available random percept-action data.
Select the transformer architecture through neural architecture search.
Distill neural policies into symbolic policies for self-reflection, teaching, and learning.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports substantially faster distillation and empirical comparisons of distillation methods and symbolic policy spaces, including their effects on A-life population dynamics, but gives no numerical results.
watch_item: Policy fidelity and transfer performance require validation for each symbolic language and agent environment.
paper_title: Using Transformers for Teaching and Learning via Symbolic Distillation of Neural A-life Agents
